channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: GamingCon Bharat 2026 to Return to Mumbai for Third Edition in October
item.description: GamingCon Bharat will return to Mumbai on 17–18 October at NESCO, bringing together gamers, creators, brands and esports professionals for its third edition.

item.title: TTK Prestige Showcases Kitchen Innovation at HT City Unwind Delhi 2025
item.description: TTK Prestige showcased its latest Triply cookware range and Endura 6-Jar Mixer Grinder at HT City Unwind Delhi 2025, engaging audiences through live culinary demonstrations and immersive brand experiences.

item.title: NeoNiche Marks 15-Year Milestone with Focus on Experiential Growth and Strategic Expansion
item.description: NeoNiche has completed 15 years of operations, reporting steady growth and expansion across multiple verticals while outlining plans for its next phase of strategic development.

item.title: From Policy to Innovation: ET NOW Global Business Summit 2026 Frames the Next Global Growth Narrative
item.description: The ET NOW Global Business Summit 2026 brought policymakers and global leaders together in New Delhi, spotlighting India’s reform-led growth agenda and its roadmap to 2047.

item.title: Percept ICE Showcases Innovation Across Swadesh, Hamleys, Kylie and Global Trade Platforms
item.description: Percept ICE has delivered a series of bespoke exhibition environments for brands including Swadesh, Hamleys, Kylie X Cosmic 2.0 and Jio World Convention Centre across major Indian and global platforms.

item.title: An Artist, A Pineapple Thrown at Audiences and Rs. 5 lakhs Event Insurance Claim
item.description: A concert attendee has filed a Rs. 5 lakhs+ claim after allegedly fracturing his hand while blocking a pineapple thrown during a live performance, with PROADVICE Wealth IMF Pvt Ltd negotiating on behalf of the organizer.

item.title: The Pittch and Skillbox Deliver Seamless Production for Anoushka Shankar India Tour 2026 at Drome Arena
item.description: The Pittch and Skillbox partnered to deliver end-to-end production for the Anoushka Shankar India Tour 2026 at Drome Arena, creating an immersive live music experience for diverse audiences.

item.title: Super Chennai Conclave 2026 Puts Sustainability and Infrastructure at Core of City’s Growth Agenda
item.description: Sustainability and infrastructure emerged as key growth drivers at the inaugural Super Chennai Conclave 2026, as policymakers and industry leaders advanced a citizen-led roadmap for the city’s future.

item.title: A Decade of Stories, A Future of Empathy: Roshan Abbas on 10 Years of Spoken Fest

item.title: Chennaiyin FC Sign Indian Super Gaming League as Principal Sponsor for ISL 2026
item.description: Chennaiyin FC have named Indian Super Gaming League as their principal sponsor for the 2026 ISL season, with ISGL set to feature on the club’s matchday jerseys and training kits.
